desc: Continue paired AppleT6040PCIe static tracing after ticket 068 proved clkgen PLL lock but reg[3]+0x90 still hangs. Resolve every remaining operation before the first _readPhyIPReg, especially PHY-IP power/reset/domain ownership, against ADT indices and exact accessors. Produce a proof/no-go or one separately gated candidate; no rig, no guessed offsets, and never retry 068 unchanged.
progress: 2026-07-26 (done/2026-07-26-t6040-pcie-initializephy-trace.md): decoded _initializePhy's first hardware op = PhyCommon reg 0x0 bit-0 RMW; accessors show shared PHY aperture with PhyCommon at +0x4000, PhyPhy at +0x8000, PHY-IP base cached at this+0x240 (068 hang is a non-responding aperture, not a null ptr). Read /arm-io/apcie0 over the live proxy: no reg-names (index-mapped), 35 entries = 7 header + 4 ports x 7. Resolved absolute addrs: reg[2]=0x217000000 shared PHY => PhyCommon[0]=0x217004000, PhyPhy=0x217008000, op-115 PHY-IP read=0x217048090 (port0, +port*0x8000). Grounded missing precondition: set bit0 of 0x217004000 + PhyPhy setup at 0x217008000 before reading 0x217048090; m1n1 does neither. REMAINING (needs attended session, not autonomous): live PHY-aperture read risks ungated-SError wedge (NVMe class); exact PhyPhy reg/val pairs + second PhyCommon write; definitive dtRegMapApcieCommonIndex(reg[1]) via probe-time ivar fill; then one separately-gated m1n1 candidate. 068 stays un-retried. | 2026-07-26 LATE, THREE FINDINGS + A CORRECTION. (1) m1n1 NEVER WRITES any PCIe register on T6040: pcie_apply_local() routes to tunables_apply_local_trace() when pcie_regs==&regs_t6040, so every tunable is LOGGED not applied — hence 'T6040 AXI trace dry run complete; no PCIe MMIO'. PCIe is stubbed, not failing, so the remaining work is a bounded change to let specific tunables apply. regs_t6040's indices are independently confirmed by today's live ADT read (rc=1/phy=2/phy_ip=3/axi=4 vs reg[1]=0x214000000, reg[2]=0x217000000, reg[3]=0x217040000, reg[4]=0x216000000). (2) OP-115 IS A PLL-LOCK POLL, not an arbitrary read: the captured trace contains 'apcie-phy-ip-pll-tunables[0] read-only addr=0x417040090 size=4 mask=0x1 value=0x1' — poll bit 0 until it reads 1. So it hangs waiting for a bit that never comes up, which fits 068 (clkgen locks a PLL but not this bit), and a bare read of it is harmless — the earlier SError fear was unfounded. (3) CORRECTION: the absolute addresses I published earlier today are WRONG. Trace says PhyPhy 0x417008000 and PLL poll 0x417040090; I published 0x217008000 and 0x217048090 — a +0x200000000 alias. The OFFSETS from the disassembly (+0x8000 PhyPhy, +0x90 PLL) are confirmed exactly; only the base was wrong. AIC reports 1/2 dies so a die/alias offset is the likely cause but is NOT established. NEXT, needing no new authorisation because it writes nothing: extend the TRACE to confirm the full phy-ip-pll/auspma/cio3pllcore sets (only 1 PLL and 14 cio3pll lines appeared, possibly truncated) and resolve the 0x216/0x416 base question from the ADT. Do NOT enable writes blind — a masked RMW to a wrong PHY base is a real write to an unknown register. Evidence: done/2026-07-26-t6040-pcie-trace-mode-and-op115-identified.md. | 2026-07-27 ADDRESS CORRECTION (done/2026-07-27-t6040-adt-ranges-address-correction.md): the 0x217 vs 0x417 gap is NOT a die alias — it is the /arm-io `ranges` translation (bus 0x0 -> parent 0x200000000, size 0x480000000). adt.py .reg returns the untranslated BUS address, so add 0x200000000. DEFINITIVE absolutes: PhyCommon[0]=0x417004000, PhyPhy=0x417008000, op-115 PLL poll=0x417040090 — matching the tunables trace exactly. My earlier 0x217... values were the untranslated reads and are wrong.
